summary: Tonix Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K on August 18, 2026, announcing the appointment of Dr. Seth Lederman, its President, CEO, and Chairman, as Interim Chief Medical Officer. The transition is an internal appointment with no new terms or arrangements disclosed. Dr. Lederman, age 69, continues his existing roles. This is a management change, though not a departure; it reflects a reshuffling of executive duties. No advisors, compensation details, or structural mechanics were stated. What to watch: any subsequent permanent CMO appointment or regulatory implications from the dual role.
